finalResult.currentParagraphText: “You know what? I don’t need a bow to kill you,”
finalResult.nextParagraphText: Jake said as he dismissed his bow as he’d promised and began flying downwards.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: “If you win, my tribe shall return and leave this place... and if I win, I get your skull,” the Chieftain proposed, definitely fully aware that what he offered wasn’t really worth anything. If the Chieftain lost, he would likely be dead or incapacitated, in which case Jake and the two women would have the advantage. Meanwhile, if Jake was killed, the elf and dryad would likely be screwed or at least have to flee.
